verdict.rationale: replica-skill is a skill collection, so a skill-authoring meta-skill is a fair question for it. However, every documented skill targets app cloning: recon, planning, design, build, backend, QA, parity, rebranding, listing and shipping. Nothing in the evidence describes a skill or tool that guides an agent through writing, improving or packaging new skills.

support.subject: As a developer, the collection ships a meta-skill or tool that guides my agent through writing, improving, and packaging new skills
